subject: Pen test report & scope clarification — required artifact for GRC portal
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bigretail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Big Retail GRC Team <grc@bigretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Penetration test report required for GRC upload

Hi Neha,

Per our GRC intake (BR-77829) the procurement team is requesting the latest penetration test report as an artifact to complete the CAIQ/SIG submission. They noted that a redacted executive report is acceptable but they need: scope, test dates, high/medium/low findings, and remediation status.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the report (or a redacted summary) and whether any of the findings are still open that would impact our SOC 2 readiness? We need to move this through by Friday to keep the timeline for our procurement review.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Security Program Manager — Big Retail

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bigretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Penetration test report required for GRC upload

Jordan — thanks for the note and for flagging the GRC ticket. Looping in Rishi (SE) and Mina (Security) to confirm scope and what we can share. Vivek from Legal is cc'd for any redaction/NDAs.

Short answer: we can provide a redacted executive summary + remediation tracker and confirm SOC 2 impact. We do not share full raw test artifacts without a signed mutual NDA and controlled access. Rishi/Mina — can you confirm the specifics below so Jordan can attach what the portal asks for?

Requested items (for clarity):
- Test scope (systems and environment tested)
- Dates the test was performed
- Summary of findings by severity
- Current remediation status / ETAs
- Any remaining compensating controls if a remediation is delayed

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bigretail.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Penetration test report required for GRC upload

Jordan / Neha — quick technical summary from the SE side.

Scope summary (redwood_pen_test_summary_2026-02.pdf attached):
- In-scope: Hosted Redwood inference API endpoints (prod region us-west-2), orchestration/control plane (control plane endpoints), and auxiliary services used for telemetry and billing.
- Out-of-scope: Customer-managed private deployments and on-prem packages; third-party cloud infra beyond normal public endpoints (no VPC peering exploits were attempted).
- Test window: 2026-02-08 through 2026-02-12.

Findings (summary):
- Total findings: 7 (1 high, 3 medium, 3 low).
- High severity: a token-expiration edge case discovered in an older auth path — mitigated with a patch deployed 2026-02-18.
- Medium: two issues are code-level input sanitization gaps (remediated 2026-02-25), one is config drift in a telemetry collector (remediation in progress).
- Low: three informational items; scheduled for next maintenance.

Sharing policy: we provide an executive (redacted) report and a remediation tracker to GRC portals. Full raw test output (tool logs, raw payloads, PII samples) is only shared under our security data-sharing agreement and in a controlled location.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bigretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Penetration test report required for GRC upload

Jordan — attaching the redacted executive summary and remediation tracker; see attachments. Brief remediation status: 4/7 findings closed, 2 in-progress with ETAs, 1 compensating control in place. Details below.

Remediation status (see remediation_tracker_2026-03-15.xlsx):
- High (1): fixed and validated — root cause was an expired token logic path in legacy auth code. Change deployed 2026-02-18, validation completed 2026-02-26.
- Medium (3):
  - Input sanitization (2): fixed 2026-02-25, unit/integration tests added.
  - Telemetry config drift (1): in progress; remediation plan implemented 2026-03-02, ETA for completion 2026-03-22.
- Low (3): scheduled maintenance items; patch window 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-12.

Compensating controls: WAF rules and additional runtime checks were added to reduce exploitation risk while the telemetry config fix completes. Our SOC 2 control owner has documented the compensating controls and evidence is available if you need it for the portal.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_2026-02.pdf (executive summary, redacted), remediation_tracker_2026-03-15.xlsx (live tracker with statuses). If the portal requires the test report file name or a hash, let me know and we'll provide a signed access link under our data-sharing procedure.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
